name: Graphic Design
summary: Print, event and campaign design: flyers, leaflets, stands and social graphics that get one message across.
seoTitle: Graphic & Print Design for Brands · Mihai Boboc
seoDescription: Graphic design for campaigns, print and events: flyers, leaflets, event stands, social media and marketing materials that stay on brand and get one message across.
headline: Graphic design that gets one clear message across.
intro:
My design journey started with graphic design, and I still enjoy it: a flyer, a stand or a social post has a few seconds to land one idea. I design campaign, print and event materials that stay on brand and read at a glance.

I prepare everything for production, from print templates to the final files your printer or your team needs.

offers.title: Print materials
offers.text: Flyers, leaflets, posters and brochures with one clear job each.

offers.title: Events & large format
offers.text: Stands, gazebos, banners and roll-ups that people understand from across the street.

offers.title: Social media graphics
offers.text: Campaign posts and reusable templates that keep your feed consistent.

offers.title: Campaign design
offers.text: One look across print, social and web, so every piece supports the same message.

offers.title: Print-ready files
offers.text: Correct sizes, bleed and colour for your printer, plus editable templates for your team.

process.title: Brief
process.text: What the piece needs to do, who will see it and where.

process.title: Concept
process.text: The message and layout, kept short and built around real photos and screens.

process.title: Design
process.text: The final design on brand, reviewed with you until it’s right.

process.title: Production
process.text: Print-ready files and templates, and help with the printer if you need it.

faq.title: Can you work with our existing brand guidelines?
faq.text: Yes. I design within your brand, or help tighten it if pieces have started to drift.

faq.title: Do you prepare files for the printer?
faq.text: Yes. You get print-ready files with the right size, bleed and colour, and editable templates where they help.

faq.title: Can you also design the brand itself?
faq.text: Yes. See Brand Identity for logos, colour, typography and guidelines.

faq.title: How do we start?
faq.text: Tell me what you need and when. I’ll come back with questions and a suggested next step.

ctaText: Tell me what you need and I’ll get back to you with questions and a next step.
